$schema: Proxy Front-End Detection Annotation Schema v1

info.description: H-PROXY1 detection ground truth for target-domain video

fields.id: integer, unique frame identifier across all annotation tasks
fields.file_name: string, relative path to frame image (extracted JPEG)

fields.bbox: [x, y, width, height] in absolute pixels, top-left origin
fields.iscrowd: integer, 0 or 1 (1 if object cluster too dense for individual boxes)
fields.time_spent_sec: float, annotation time for this box

pre_annotations.description: Merged model predictions (anonymized, model source hidden)
pre_annotations.merge_strategy: Union of all boxes → IoU deduplication (threshold=0.7) → random shuffle
pre_annotations.note: Pre-annotations are provided as starting points. Annotators MUST correct, delete, or add boxes as needed.
